summary.evidenceSource: Manual baseline from the Qilianshan SDLC article
summary.cultureGoal: Show the seven Qilianshan SDLC stages, distinguish implementation status, and list each agent-owned contribution item with Agent Owner, Sub-agent Owner, Process Owner, Technical Leader, and Co-Build attribution.

stages.name: Planning
stages.implementationNote: This stage is available in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Defines project intent, approval readiness, scope, boundaries, and delivery direction.
stages.gate: Project goals, scope, boundaries, and approval evidence must be ready before downstream work starts.

workstreams.name: Project framing
workstreams.contribution: Captures goals, delivery boundaries, key milestones, and business priorities.

workstreams.name: Approval readiness
workstreams.contribution: Collects approval evidence so the project enters a traceable delivery path.

workstreams.name: Scope alignment
workstreams.contribution: Clarifies what is in scope, what is out of scope, and where scope drift should be stopped.

stages.name: Estimation
stages.implementationNote: This stage is available in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Turns schedule, cost, resource, and risk assumptions into a delivery baseline.
stages.gate: The estimation baseline must be reviewed before discovery work can exceed time, budget, or risk boundaries.

workstreams.name: Schedule estimate
workstreams.contribution: Converts delivery timing from informal judgment into a reviewable baseline.

workstreams.name: Cost and resource estimate
workstreams.contribution: Clarifies staffing, environment, tooling, and budget constraints.

workstreams.name: Risk baseline
workstreams.contribution: Locks key risks and mitigation actions as inputs for later stages.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.implementationNote: This stage is part of the target SDLC map, but it is not implemented in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Collects requirements, aligns requirement intent, and creates executable solution design.
stages.gate: Build work should not start from verbal understanding when the requirement and design baseline is incomplete.

workstreams.name: Requirement intake
workstreams.contribution: Turns business input into a traceable requirement candidate set.

workstreams.name: Requirement baseline
workstreams.contribution: Aligns requirement language so development and testing work from the same source.

workstreams.name: Solution design
workstreams.contribution: Creates executable design, interfaces, constraints, and acceptance boundaries.

stages.name: Build
stages.implementationNote: This stage is available in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Turns the approved baseline into code changes, local verification, and archived build artifacts.
stages.gate: Testing should not start without compliant artifacts and local verification evidence.

workstreams.name: Standardized development
workstreams.contribution: Turns design intent into reviewable, buildable code changes.

workstreams.name: Unit verification
workstreams.contribution: Completes the minimum local quality gate before formal testing starts.

workstreams.name: Artifact build
workstreams.contribution: Produces archived, releasable, and traceable build artifacts.

stages.name: Testing
stages.implementationNote: This stage is being built out in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Covers functional, performance, security, and compatibility validation with defect feedback into build.
stages.gate: Deployment should not proceed until test acceptance evidence is complete.

workstreams.name: Functional validation
workstreams.contribution: Verifies business behavior against the requirement and design baseline.

workstreams.name: Non-functional validation
workstreams.contribution: Adds performance, security, and compatibility evidence before release.

workstreams.name: Defect feedback
workstreams.contribution: Routes defects back into build instead of resolving them informally inside testing.

stages.name: Deployment
stages.implementationNote: This stage is available in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Coordinates test environment validation, production deployment, and launch acceptance.
stages.gate: Operations should not take ownership until launch acceptance evidence is complete.

workstreams.name: Test environment deployment
workstreams.contribution: Confirms package, environment, and test results are aligned before production release.

workstreams.name: Production deployment
workstreams.contribution: Runs controlled production deployment with evidence and rollback path.

workstreams.name: Launch acceptance
workstreams.contribution: Records launch acceptance before handoff to operations.

stages.name: Maintenance
stages.implementationNote: This stage is part of the target SDLC map, but it is not implemented in the current platform baseline.
stages.description: Owns monitoring, incident response, improvement feedback, and change traceability after launch.
stages.gate: Production feedback must be routed to the right SDLC stage instead of bypassing the process.

workstreams.name: Continuous monitoring
workstreams.contribution: Monitors service health and triggers the response path when exceptions appear.

workstreams.name: Incident response
workstreams.contribution: Records incidents, response actions, impact scope, and review evidence.

workstreams.name: Improvement feedback
workstreams.contribution: Routes production feedback back into the correct SDLC stage.
